name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v553: fixes visible Cloudflare dialog being invisible when toggle OFF. (1) bottom sheet now starts expanded (startExpanded = true) so it is actually seen on phone and TV — previously peekHeight 0 left it collapsed/invisible. (2) Added logging in showCloudflareBypass and showVisible to trace webViewVisible value on both platforms. (3) All v552 fixes retained: storedActivity cache so bypass always finds Activity on TV, bypass always opens when no cookie exists, deferred always completed, stale fragment cleanup, one-solve-at-a-time, per-host cookies, client hints, empty-UA guard, D-pad cursor bounds, TV invisible→visible fallback.
